say:1:1620225001:1.text: Welcome, Evie and Merlin! Now that everyone's here, let's begin!
say:1:1620225001:1.source_cn: 伊芙，梅林，你们来了。嗯……人到齐了，我们开始吧！
say:1:1620225001:1.male: Welcome, Evie and Merlin! Now that everyone's here, let's begin!
say:1:1620225001:1.female: Welcome, Evie and Merlin! Now that everyone's here, let's begin!

say:5:1620225003:1.text: Greetings, students. Today, I'm here on Her Majesty's behalf to host this awards ceremony.
say:5:1620225003:1.source_cn: 各位莱希拉姆的学生们，日安。今天，我奉我母亲之令前来，...

say:6:1620225004:1.text: The campus recently faced a challenging situation, but it's been resolved through the dedicated efforts of Envoy Evie and Magister Merlin!
say:6:1620225004:1.source_cn: 前一段时间发生的事情，想必大家都有耳闻。我很高兴地告诉...
say:6:1620225004:1.male: The campus recently faced a challenging situation, but it's been resolved through the dedicated efforts of Envoy Evie and Magister Merlin!
say:6:1620225004:1.female: The campus recently faced a challenging situation, but it's been resolved through the dedicated efforts of Envoy Evie and Magister Merlin!

say:7:1620225005:1.text: Now, I want to shine the spotlight on some of you who played an important role in this matter.
say:7:1620225005:1.source_cn: 但或许有人还不知道，在这次事件中，莱希拉姆的几位学生也...

say:8:1620225006:1.text: This ceremony is dedicated to them. Their names will be remembered, and their valor will be celebrated.
say:8:1620225006:1.source_cn: 这场小型典礼就是为了他们而举行的。我希望莱希拉姆的所有...

say:9:1620225007:1.text: First of all, we have Pippa.

say:11:1620225008:1.text: Am I really getting an award? Wow, this feels like a dream!
say:11:1620225008:1.source_cn: 欸，真的要给我颁奖吗？哇，简直像是在做梦一样！

say:12:1620225009:1.text: Pippa looks thrilled. Her excitement is tinged with a hint of nerves, evident through her wagging tail.
say:12:1620225009:1.source_cn: 皮帕又惊又喜地走上前，她的尾巴抖动着，看上去很兴奋——...
say:12:1620225009:1.male: Pippa looks thrilled. Her excitement is tinged with a hint of nerves, evident through her wagging tail.
say:12:1620225009:1.female: Pippa looks thrilled. Her excitement is tinged with a hint of nerves, evident through her wagging tail.

say:13:1620225010:1.text: You'll receive a lifelong grant to cover all your future research expenses, including any losses caused by your transformations.
say:13:1620225010:1.source_cn: 你将获得一笔无限期礼金，用于承担你未来所有魔法研究的费...

say:14:1620225011:1.text: Under Her Majesty's instructions to the Academy Board, any unintentional damages you cause to the campus will no longer be treated as violations.
say:14:1620225011:1.source_cn: 另外，为了解决你一直以来的担忧，王后陛下已经特别嘱咐莱...

say:15:1620225012:1.text: Wow, this is perfect! I won't have to worry about being expelled anymore!
say:15:1620225012:1.source_cn: 哇，好贴心的奖励！太棒了，这样我就不用再担心会被退学了！

say:16:1620225013:1.text: I'm glad you like it! I'm sure the board would do anything to keep a talented student like you.
say:16:1620225013:1.source_cn: 哈哈哈，当然啦，我想莱希拉姆也不会舍得让你这么厉害的学...

say:20:1620225015:2.text: Cassadee gives Peggy a flawless curtsy. It is clear she has been practicing court etiquette diligently to prepare for her role as a court mage.
say:20:1620225015:2.source_cn: 科丝蒂向佩吉行了一礼，动作非常标准。你看得出来，为了能...
say:20:1620225015:2.male: Cassadee gives Peggy a flawless curtsy. It is clear she has been practicing court etiquette diligently to prepare for her role as a court mage.
say:20:1620225015:2.female: Cassadee gives Peggy a flawless curtsy. It is clear she has been practicing court etiquette diligently to prepare for her role as a court mage.

say:22:1620225016:1.text: Her Majesty is pleased to have you as her court mage. In addition to the grant, she has arranged a comfortable home for you and your family in Savannah.
say:22:1620225016:1.source_cn: 王后陛下很高兴你能成为宫廷魔法师，除了礼金之外，她还为...

say:23:1620225017:1.text: Thank you, Your Highness. Please convey my gratitude to Her Majesty.
say:23:1620225017:1.source_cn: 谢谢您，佩吉公主，也请您替我向王后陛下道谢。

say:24:1620225018:1.text: I look forward to serving the court in Savannah and hope to be a valuable addition to the court mage team.
say:24:1620225018:1.source_cn: 我很期待在赛凡纳宫廷任职，希望我的加入能够为宫廷魔法师...

say:25:1620225019:1.text: Though amused by Cassadee's stiff tone, you are glad to see her so well-prepared for her new role.
say:25:1620225019:1.source_cn: 你觉得很有趣，科丝蒂的场面话虽然还有些生硬，但这或许是...
say:25:1620225019:1.male: Though amused by Cassadee's stiff tone, you are glad to see her so well-prepared for her new role.
say:25:1620225019:1.female: Though amused by Cassadee's stiff tone, you are glad to see her so well-prepared for her new role.

say:26:1620225020:2.text: Knowing Cassadee's usual candor, Peggy is surprised by her speech. She gives you a sly wink before trying her best to look serious again.
say:26:1620225020:2.source_cn: 很明显，见识过科丝蒂耿直思维的佩吉对她的变化也有些惊讶...
say:26:1620225020:2.male: Knowing Cassadee's usual candor, Peggy is surprised by her speech. She gives you a sly wink before trying her best to look serious again.
say:26:1620225020:2.female: Knowing Cassadee's usual candor, Peggy is surprised by her speech. She gives you a sly wink before trying her best to look serious again.

say:27:1620225021:1.text: Cassadee, I can't wait to meet you in Savannah and see you wearing your court mage's robes!
say:27:1620225021:1.source_cn: 科丝蒂，希望你早点来赛凡纳，我可是很期待你穿上宫廷魔法...

say:29:1620225022:1.text: Last but not least, it's Silven.
say:29:1620225022:1.source_cn: 好啦，轮到最后一位了——休。

say:31:1620225023:2.text: Silven takes a deep breath, steps forward, and bows to Princess Peggy. You know he is more excited about the honor than Cassadee or Pippa.
say:31:1620225023:2.source_cn: 休深吸了一口气，走上前来，向着佩吉公主行礼。你很明白，...
say:31:1620225023:2.male: Silven takes a deep breath, steps forward, and bows to Princess Peggy. You know he is more excited about the honor than Cassadee or Pippa.
say:31:1620225023:2.female: Silven takes a deep breath, steps forward, and bows to Princess Peggy. You know he is more excited about the honor than Cassadee or Pippa.

say:32:1620225024:1.text: Because it could mark the beginning of his family's resurgence.
say:32:1620225024:1.source_cn: 因为，这或许就是他复兴家族的开始。
say:32:1620225024:1.male: Because it could mark the beginning of his family's resurgence.
say:32:1620225024:1.female: Because it could mark the beginning of his family's resurgence.

say:34:1620225025:1.text: *Cough* Silven, I have a message from the Queen for you.
say:34:1620225025:1.source_cn: 咳，休……下面的这些话是王后陛下说的，我只是转述给你听。

say:35:1620225026:1.text: "Silven Grenvalden, it delights me to witness another rising star from your family after a century of silence."
say:35:1620225026:1.source_cn: “休，你是格伦沃顿家族的后裔，我很高兴看到这个英雄的姓...

say:36:1620225027:1.text: "I won't grant you wealth, for that is not what you seek. Instead, I will offer you an honor..."
say:36:1620225027:1.source_cn: “我不准备给你财物，因为这非你所求。我要给你的是一份荣...

say:37:1620225028:1.text: "I hereby confer knighthood upon you. May you remain true to your vow, to yourself, and to your righteous spirit."
say:37:1620225028:1.source_cn: “我敕封休·格伦沃顿为骑士。愿他坚守誓言，不违本心，永...

say:38:1620225029:1.text: "Restore your family's glory with your courage, wisdom, and strength!"
say:38:1620225029:1.source_cn: “愿他凭着勇气、智慧和力量，亲手取回家族失落的荣光！”

say:39:1620225030:1.text: ... Your Highness, do you mean... Her Majesty has knighted me?!
say:39:1620225030:1.source_cn: ……佩吉殿下，您说……陛下敕封我为骑士？！

say:40:1620225031:1.text: You heard that right. Her Majesty thinks highly of you. Don't let her down, Sir Silven Grenvalden.
say:40:1620225031:1.source_cn: 对呀，母亲很看好你的，别让她失望哦，骑士先生。

say:41:1620225032:1.text: I... don't know what to say... Thank you, Your Highness. Please, if you would, convey my reply to Her Majesty.
say:41:1620225032:1.source_cn: 我不知道该说什么……感谢您，佩吉殿下，请您向王后陛下带...

say:42:1620225033:1.text: "I, Silven Grenvalden, pledge to uphold Your Majesty's command. In adherence to the sacred code of knighthood, I shall, with courage, wisdom, and strength, restore my family to its former glory!"
say:42:1620225033:1.source_cn: 我，休·格伦沃顿，我会遵照陛下的旨意，秉承骑士信念，凭...

say:43:1620225034:1.text: Do you need a moment to calm down, Silven?
say:43:1620225034:1.source_cn: 好啦好啦，休，你要不要先平复一下心情？

say:45:1620225035:1.text: You have to ready yourself for the knighting ceremony later.
say:45:1620225035:1.source_cn: 你现在这么激动，可不适合进行敕封仪式呦。
